input.brief: Bendbound mobile motorcycle route planner, map, saved tours and rider profile. Preserve approved logo, charcoal surfaces, red routes and cyan actions; native system typography.

style.name: True-black flat
style.basis: 5 screens: an events back office, an event analytics tab, a community overview, an artist studio home, an artist insights page
style.idea: Night mode on true black: sidebar, top bar and page share one ground, elevation is a lightness step alone, and colour is confined to data marks.
style.colourBudget: at or under 3%; the accent never touches buttons, tabs or nav

font.note: Nothing above 600; inactive nav labels #bbb, active #fff.

style.signature: Elevation by lightness alone (#000 ground, #111 card, #2a2a2a nested panel) with no borders or shadows on cards; the active nav item is marked only by its label going from #bbb to #fff; the primary control is made primary by inversion, a white 36px pill with black text.
identity: The one data hue from the product's world in place of the dealt lime: a solar amber (#f2b33d) for an energy home, a sky blue (#4cb3f0) for water or weather, a lime only for sport. It is still the only hue on data and never touches buttons, tabs or nav. A green or yellow-green hue is also --positive; an amber that sits beside --warning leaves the warning to its pill pair.

A ground with the product's temperature: the studied #000 for media and events, a warm near-black (#0e0d0c) for a home, a cool one (#0c0d0f) for a monitor, with cards one lightness step above it (#181716, #15171a). Never navy or slate.

A signature element from the product's world as the lead: the energy home's power flow (sun, house, battery and grid with their live kW), an event's doors against capacity, an artist's release with its cover.
avoid: a navy or slate dark theme
a hue per chart (five hues across four charts was flagged)
the accent on buttons, tabs or nav
a 64px top bar left empty across most of its width (flagged twice)
style.notes: The studied screens of this kind used a violet-magenta (#dd6cff) and an orange (#ff5500) as their one data hue. The library deals a lime, which keeps the move and stays clear of the violet ban; because the lime is a yellow-green, it is also the positive colour (a second, mint green beside it read as two greens). The greys are #b4b4b4 for secondary text and #949494 for meta, 32 levels apart rather than the 20 of the measured #aaa and #969696, which read as one grey; #949494 still holds 4.5:1 on the #2a2a2a nested panel.

shell.name: Ruled T-frame

numbers.switcher: at the top bar's right end, behind a full-height 1px divider
numbers.contentGutter: 29px from the sidebar rule and the window edge

shell.blueprint: A 210-240px sidebar and a 64px top bar share one ground, divided only by 1px rules. The workspace or community switcher sits at the right end of the top bar behind a full-height divider; the sidebar holds the wordmark and the nav on a 34px pitch with sentence-case group labels. On dark, the active item is its label going from #bbb to #fff. The top bar must carry something real (search, the back link and object name, the switcher): two studied screens left about 1070px of it blank and were flagged.
shell.phone: The top bar stays at 48-56px with the switcher reduced to its mark; the sidebar becomes a full-screen menu sheet or a bottom bar of four or five destinations.

pattern.name: Table with tabs and a filter bar
pattern.basis: an events back office, a tracks studio, a sessions overview
pattern.blueprint: Title row: an 18-24px title on the left, at most an outlined secondary and the one primary (36px) on the right. Underline tabs for the list's states on a full-width 1px rule with a 2px indicator as wide as the label; 22-32px below, the toolbar: a search of about 252-316 x 32-36 on the left, the count ('7 events') and the sort on the right. The table sits on the panel or page ground with no card around it: a header of 12-13px grey sentence-case labels with no fill and no rule, rows on a 48-56px pitch for one line or 72-92px with a thumbnail (media height plus 24-32px), 1px rules 3-7% darker than the ground or no rules at all, the identity column given the most width, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures with the unit muted ('5 /10'), one status mark per row and one kebab at the far right. Drop a column that is empty in every row (a blank co-host column left a 300px dead band). On an overview, cap the rows and link to the full list; on the full list, state the total and load more at the end.
pattern.phone: Rows become two-line items: identity and the key number on line 1, the secondary fields in 13px grey on line 2, the kebab at the right. Tabs scroll in their own row; the search becomes a full-width field.

pattern.name: Settings in two columns
pattern.basis: one settings page; stacking from a narrow rail card. The basis is thin.
pattern.blueprint: A centred column of about 1152px. Each section is one row: a label column of about 450px (16/500 title, 14px grey description; the title's cap top 6-8px below the panel top, level with the panel's first line) beside a panel of about 700px with a #fafafa fill, 16px radius, 16px padding, no border and no shadow. Sections are split by a full-width 1px rule with 32px above and below. Inside a panel: field labels 14/500 above 40px white inputs (1px #e8e8e8, radius 10), 8px from label to field, 16px between fields, 24px from the description to the first label, 16px to the Save button; switch rows with a 14/500 title, a 20px status badge 8px after it, a 14px grey description and a 28x16 toggle 16px from the right edge, centred on the title line. A plan-gated feature shows a 48px tinted strip with a 32px button directly above its panel, and the panel stays readable. When a panel runs much taller than its label, put the section's help or a summary of the current values in the label column rather than 250px of nothing.
pattern.phone: Each section stacks: title and description, then the panel at full width. Inside, label, 8-10px, field, 16-26px to the next pair; toggles stay on the right of their title.
